pins: under a declared Andon field on GitHub, a workflow that runs on main with no job that pulls the cord on its failure is PIPE-25, filed at that workflow; a workflow whose last job pulls it is not flagged, and neither is that job's issues: write grant nor an MR failure that only its author hears
